component.name: Day Planner
component.summary: Plan your day and track the time you spend on tasks

description.p: Day Planner is a light task list with time tracking for Phosh phones and the desktop. It keeps your tasks in the backup format of Super Productivity, so a backup moves between both apps without changes.

ul.li: Tasks with subtasks, notes, estimates and a planned day
A timer per task that books the time on the day you worked
Repeating tasks, the same way as in Super Productivity
Habit journeys: small steps that grow, calm or with a game layer
Import and export of Super Productivity backups, and automatic backups
Works offline; needs no account and no network

description.p: Day Planner is an independent project and not affiliated with the Super Productivity project.

ul.li: Journeys: turn a habit into small steps that grow, with QuestArc's journeys, calm or with game, on the same data as Super Productivity's QuestArc plugin.
Tasks can repeat: every day, Monday to Friday, weekly, monthly, yearly or on a custom schedule, the same way as in Super Productivity.
Adding tasks, search, new lists, Mark as Done and the timer moved to the bottom of the screen, where the thumb reaches them.
Deleting a task or a list and finishing the day can be undone from the message that follows.
The app is now called Day Planner.
Choosing another project on a task's page no longer closes the app.
The journey no longer opens after every change in your lists; it comes forward only when you tick off its station's task.
Swiping from the left edge goes back again, from a task to its list and from a list to the lists.
On the phone, a swipe from a list goes back to the overview of lists, as in Ephyra.

description.p: First version: Today, projects and tags, tasks with subtasks and a timer, in Super Productivity's backup format.
